hypothesis: The corrected fresh15 v3 live candle and order-book inputs reproduce the archive signal inputs and completed-bar decisions closely enough that historical and prospective route evidence can be compared without a source-contract alias.
problem_statement: The v3 transport defects are repaired, but row-for-row candle parity and pressure-decision parity between the archive and live sources remain unverified. Until resolved, historical route economics and future live outcomes cannot be attributed to the same mechanism with high confidence.

historical_context.interpretation: The old source-contract result remains a valid rejection of that exact archive experiment. The v3 transport repair is new technical evidence, not evidence of profitability and not permission to reopen the sealed holdout.

experiment.name: prospective_index_candle_pressure_and_decision_parity
experiment.downside: requires prospective elapsed time and can reveal that historical and live signals are not comparable

collection_state.note: A bounded 164-bar prefix per symbol was sealed and hashed. Collection continues for forward live outcomes, but the declared historical/live source-parity hypothesis is resolved as false.

result.interpretation: Live v3 candleSnapshot plus receipt-causal REST depth and the historical public-trade plus WebSocket-L2 archive are materially different decision mechanisms. The earlier archive rejection cannot be represented as an exact backtest of live v3. This does not establish profitable live-v3 edge; its current-epoch after-cost lifecycle count remains zero.

minimum_additional_evidence.reason_for_96_bars: covers at least 24 hours and exceeds the 55-bar EMA warmup with a nontrivial ready-decision window
minimum_additional_evidence.path_audit: all gaps explicit; unresolved path coverage cannot be success-shaped
minimum_additional_evidence.candle_parity: row-for-row completed-bar OHLC comparison with every mismatch serialized
minimum_additional_evidence.signal_parity: zero unexplained differences in entry, exit, stop, and pressure-decision fields after warmup
minimum_additional_evidence.observer_decision_parity: non-vacuous overlap between archived reconstruction and durable prospective observer decisions
minimum_additional_evidence.eligible_onset_requirement: at least one eligible onset per symbol before claiming decision parity is economically informative; otherwise continue collection
minimum_additional_evidence.costed_outcome_requirement: no profitability inference until attributable live lifecycles include exact fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop behavior, and largest-winner sensitivity

decision_rules.proceed_to_economic_review: technical source parity resolves and forward live lifecycle evidence becomes non-vacuous
decision_rules.revise_source_adapter: completed-bar or pressure-decision mismatches are reproducible and attributable to source semantics
decision_rules.reject_comparability: material source mismatches remain after exact timestamp, receipt-cutoff, and duplicate reconciliation
decision_rules.insufficient: fewer than 96 completed bars, unresolved gaps, or no eligible onsets
decision_rules.live_route_change: requires a separate 15-field proposal and explicit human approval

current_recommendation: Keep the explicitly authorized v51 routes unchanged while collecting attributable live-v3 outcomes. Do not use the old archive replay as an exact economic verdict on live v3, and do not loosen gates, change leverage, or alter exits until a separate source-contract proposal is reviewed and explicitly approved.
known_failure_modes: REST and WebSocket book snapshots can differ at the same nominal boundary
public trade OHLC and candleSnapshot OHLC can differ due to aggregation semantics
sparse or absent eligible onsets can make decision agreement vacuous
recorder gaps, delayed receipts, or duplicate conflicts can invalidate completed bars
technical parity does not establish positive after-cost expectancy
falsifiers: a bounded source audit shows exact row-for-row candle and pressure-decision parity across the declared window
a reproducible mismatch demonstrates the sources are not interchangeable
new non-overlapping venue-matched outcomes show robust after-cost behavior and update the old mechanism rejection
the active run, route identity, or frozen configuration changes before the evidence window is sealed
